title: 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LF1LD_1LE0RD_1LB---_1LA0LA: the run from 10^3200 gets past phase 13,008
text: At phase 13,008 the descents first run out of [100] fuel: the next block down is the top of a 70-block base-4 ladder, which three hits turn into fuel while the other 4.8×10<sup>41</sup> hits pile up above it. The accelerator's ladder now takes such levels (ones that keep every hit, hold a literal fuel, or count down and refuel), also inside the engine's own recursion, and the hits take under a second. Checked against plain hits (same tape and step count) and on the twin's 7th event. The run goes on with ×16 and ×256 phases on the stack's fuels; the 8th event is not reached yet.
